sourceChecks.text: Sons were born to David in Hebron. His firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: アヒノアムの子アムノンがダビデの長子として挙げられる。

sourceChecks.text: After this, Absalom the son of David had a beautiful sister, whose name was Tamar; and Amnon the son of David loved her.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はアムノンをダビデの子、タマルの兄とし、彼がタマルを愛したと記す。

sourceChecks.text: Amnon was so troubled that he became sick because of his sister Tamar, for she was a virgin, and it seemed hard to Amnon to do anything to her.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はアムノンを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: But Amnon had a friend whose name was Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother; and Jonadab was a very subtle man.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はアムノンを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: He said to him, “Why, son of the king, are you so sad from day to day? Won’t you tell me?” Amnon said to him, “I love Tamar, my brother Absalom’s sister.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はアムノンを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: So Amnon lay down and faked being sick. When the king came to see him, Amnon said to the king, “Please let my sister Tamar come and make me a couple of cakes in my sight, that I may eat from her hand.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はアムノンを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Then David sent home to Tamar, saying, “Go now to your brother Amnon’s house, and prepare food for him.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はアムノンを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon’s house; and he was lying down. She took dough, kneaded it, made cakes in his sight, and baked the cakes.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: タマルへの出来事を本文がアムノンの名とともに記す。

sourceChecks.text: She took the pan and poured them out before him, but he refused to eat. Amnon said, “Have all men leave me.” Then every man went out from him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: タマルへの出来事を本文がアムノンの名とともに記す。

sourceChecks.text: Amnon said to Tamar, “Bring the food into the room, that I may eat from your hand.” Tamar took the cakes which she had made, and brought them into the room to Amnon her brother.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: タマルへの出来事を本文がアムノンの名とともに記す。

sourceChecks.text: Then Amnon hated her with exceedingly great hatred; for the hatred with which he hated her was greater than the love with which he had loved her. Amnon said to her, “Arise, be gone!”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: タマルへの出来事を本文がアムノンの名とともに記す。

sourceChecks.text: Absalom her brother said to her, “Has Amnon your brother been with you? But now hold your peace, my sister. He is your brother. Don’t take this thing to heart.” So Tamar remained desolate in her brother Absalom’s house.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はアムノンを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Absalom spoke to Amnon neither good nor bad; for Absalom hated Amnon, because he had forced his sister Tamar.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はアムノンを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Then Absalom said, “If not, please let my brother Amnon go with us.” The king said to him, “Why should he go with you?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はアムノンを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: But Absalom pressed him, and he let Amnon and all the king’s sons go with him.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文はアムノンを名指す。

sourceChecks.text: Absalom commanded his servants, saying, “Mark now, when Amnon’s heart is merry with wine; and when I tell you, ‘Strike Amnon,’ then kill him. Don’t be afraid. Haven’t I commanded you? Be courageous, and be valiant!”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: アブサロムの命令による殺害と、アムノンの死後の反応に関する記述。

sourceChecks.text: The servants of Absalom did to Amnon as Absalom had commanded. Then all the king’s sons arose, and every man got up on his mule and fled.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: アブサロムの命令による殺害と、アムノンの死後の反応に関する記述。

sourceChecks.text: Jonadab the son of Shimeah, David’s brother, answered, “Don’t let my lord suppose that they have killed all the young men, the king’s sons, for Amnon only is dead; for by the appointment of Absalom this has been determined from the day that he forced his sister Tamar.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: アブサロムの命令による殺害と、アムノンの死後の反応に関する記述。

sourceChecks.text: Now therefore don’t let my lord the king take the thing to his heart, to think that all the king’s sons are dead; for only Amnon is dead.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: アブサロムの命令による殺害と、アムノンの死後の反応に関する記述。

sourceChecks.text: King David longed to go out to Absalom, for he was comforted concerning Amnon, since he was dead.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: アブサロムの命令による殺害と、アムノンの死後の反応に関する記述。
